experiment: Day 6 targeted tutorial generation and training plumbing
representation: A 20-element tuple of legal 10-bit simulator row masks plus one current tetromino; metadata contains family, source, and perturbation but no action label or reward.
generation_algorithm: From frozen natural Day 5 rl@3000 history, retain plausible historical states and add one deterministic random legal-placement neighbor per state with a seeded next piece. Rank candidates independently per family by the preregistered sensitivity metric, deduplicate board/piece pairs, require at least four source positions, and retain eight.
targeting_metric: For every legal placement, compute the unchanged Day 4 18-feature vector. For a family, take max-minus-min for each member feature and average those ranges. Tutorial validation compares the mean sensitivity of its eight states with the generic set mean for that family.
diversity_requirement: Eight unique board/piece pairs and at least four distinct historical source positions per family; at least one generated one-legal-placement neighbor.
personalized_allocation: Restrict the Day 5 ranking to supported families, take the first two, normalize their nonnegative Day 5 scores, and allocate 24 exposures with deterministic largest remainder (equal split if both scores are zero). Cycle within each family set.
generic_control: Ignore the weakness profile, deterministically shuffle the same plausible natural/one-step candidate pool with seed+1, deduplicate, and take eight states.
exposure_accounting: One situation, one stochastic choose_placement(learn=True), one update with unchanged Day 4 gameplay_reward, and one finish_episode(learned=True). Reset after every placement. Both conditions receive exactly 24 placements, updates, and scenario resets.
success_criterion: Selection differs for the natural and contrasting profiles; every state has at least two legal actions and is replayable; each family targeted mean sensitivity is at least 1.25 times generic; standard Day 4 source is unchanged; both training conditions apply exactly 24 standard RL updates; expert calls during learning are zero; rewards are only Day 4 gameplay_reward; each set has eight unique boards and at least four origins; source history is unchanged; generator/selector AST contains no hidden-weight or oracle references.
no_tuning_rule: Run the final generation and independent validator once under these thresholds. Report a null result without redesigning against final cases.
